experiment: B1-B5 search with known ENC chart-aid coordinates
catalog: AIS vessel records plus typed ENC aid records
main_algorithms: 1 km hierarchical grid with four refinement levels and beam width 8
success_criterion: position error <= 250 m and at least 3 correct AIS associations
association_reporting: Known chart-aid matches are counted separately; success association counts include AIS matches only.
raw_data_policy: Raw AIS rows, ENC point coordinates, and rendered map imagery are not included.
